title: fix(hono): on a createHonoApp host, GET /mcp/skill answers the raw markdown; a stream's string event is written as given and a producer header replaces the default it names
body:
Fixes #24287

Clause-②: no

Basis for the Clause-② line: a wrong response body and a doubled header on one adapter are made to match the `result` stream channel's stated contract (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`: "string events are written verbatim, custom headers honored") and the standalone server's answer. No request is newly accepted or refused, and no export moves (the only source change is inside `toResponse`, a closure in `createHonoApp`).

## What a caller gets on a `createHonoApp` host

`GET /api/v1/mcp/skill`, measured with the probe's fixture skill (front matter and a double-quoted heading; the conformance pin's fixture adds an em dash):

| | before (`fa501123b`, unfixed `index.ts`) | after (`32900fd25`) | standalone server |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| body, `app.request` | `data: "---\nname: objectstack\n---\n\n# skill \"q\"\n"` plus a blank line (an SSE frame of a JSON string) | the markdown, byte for byte | the markdown, byte for byte |
| `content-type`, `app.request` | `text/markdown; charset=utf-8, text/markdown; charset=utf-8` | `text/markdown; charset=utf-8` | `text/markdown; charset=utf-8` |
| `cache-control`, `app.request` | `no-cache, no-store` | `no-store` | `no-store` |
| wire header lines, real socket (`@hono/node-server` serving `app.fetch`) | `Content-Type`, `Cache-Control: no-cache`, `Connection`, `content-type`, `content-disposition`, `cache-control: no-store` (two `Content-Type` lines, two `Cache-Control` lines) | one each of `content-type`, `cache-control: no-store`, `content-disposition`, `connection` | (pinned in `mcp-skill-method-not-allowed.hono.integration.test.ts`) |

The real-socket rows come from a one-off probe (a `LiteKernel` with a fake `mcp` service, `createHonoApp`, `serve({ fetch: app.fetch, port: 0 })`, read with `node:http` `rawHeaders`), run against the built `@objectstack/hono` dist before and after the fix. It is not a committed test; the card had that socket as NOT MEASURED.

## Where the fix lives

`packages/adapters/hono/src/index.ts`, `toResponse`'s events arm (the claim's narrowed home). Measured against the card's two mechanisms:

- **Body.** The arm wrote every event as `data: ${JSON.stringify(event)}` unless `vercelDataStream` was set (`:835`–`:837` on `21070a2f0`). It now writes a string event as given in every mode; an object event is still one `data:` frame (one JSON line in a Vercel data stream). That is the standalone writer's rule (`runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts`, `sendResultBase`).
- **Headers.** The arm spread the domain's lowercase `content-type` / `cache-control` into a record beside its own capitalised `Content-Type` / `Cache-Control`, and `new Response` appended both. It now seeds a `Headers` with the same three defaults and `set`s each producer header over them, so a producer's header replaces the default it names whatever its case. The standalone writer does the same with `res.header()`.

The domain's channel (`mcp.ts`, held by #24251) was not needed: its contract was right and this adapter was the one door not honouring it.

## Producers that reach this arm (on `origin/main` `21070a2f0`)

The arm runs for a dispatcher `result` with `type: 'stream'` and `events`. Only two domains return one:

| producer | events | `vercelDataStream` | answer after this PR |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `/mcp/skill` (`runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`) | one string (the markdown) | no | changed: the defect fixed |
| `/ai` routes via `runtime/src/domains/ai.ts`, Vercel data stream (`service-ai`'s `/ai/chat`, `/ai/agents/:agentName/chat` with its quota refusal, `/ai/assistant/chat`) | pre-encoded string frames from `encodeVercelDataStream`, ending `data: [DONE]` | yes | unchanged (strings were already verbatim in this mode) |
| `/ai` routes via `ai.ts`, plain SSE (`service-ai`'s `/ai/chat/stream`) | `aiService.streamChat()` parts, which are objects (`TextStreamPart`; the memory and Vercel adapters both yield objects) | no | unchanged (objects keep their `data:` frame) |

The `service-ai` rows were read from the published `@objectstack/service-ai@10.3.0` tarball (`dist/index.js`), since that package lives outside this repository. Every other `result` producer (`auth`, `approvals`, `automation-hooks`, `webhooks`) hands a `Response` and leaves at the arm above. No producer relies on SSE framing of a string event, so no design question arose.

## Tests

- `packages/adapters/hono/src/hono-stream-events-framing.test.ts` (fixture dispatcher): the `/mcp/skill` shape answers the markdown verbatim with each declared header once; object events outside a Vercel data stream are still SSE frames under the SSE defaults; the `/ai` SSE shape and the `/ai` Vercel data stream shape answer exactly as before.
- `packages/qa/http-conformance/src/hono-mcp-skill-raw-body.conformance.test.ts` (real `LiteKernel`, real `HttpDispatcher`, `@objectstack/hono` aliased to source): on the hosted door the body is the markdown and `content-type`, `content-disposition` and `cache-control` each have the one value the domain declares; the hosted answer equals the standalone answer (`HonoServerPlugin` + dispatcher plugin over a real socket) in status, body and those headers.

Runs at `32900fd25`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/hono test` 215 passed (11 files), exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/hono typecheck` exit 0 (the new test file is in `tsconfig.test.json`'s program, counted with `--listFiles`); `pnpm --filter @objectstack/http-conformance exec vitest run` over the new file plus `hono-head-as-get` and `hono-dispatcher-result-response`, 29 passed, exit 0; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/http-conformance typecheck` exit 0.

## Reverse verification and ablation

- **Before the fix** (`fa501123b`: tests committed, `index.ts` unfixed): both conformance cases and the unit `/mcp/skill` case red on the body (`data: "---\nname: objectstack\n…"` received); the three other unit cases green.
- **Leg A, header merge** (`headers.set(k, String(v))` to `headers.append(k, String(v))`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, blob `62e6f29d4016` to `e958969acbd3`): unit 3 of 4 red, conformance 2 of 2 red. Direction: more red than the old defect, because `append` also doubles a same-case header (the `/ai` rows), which the old record spread did not. Restored: blob back to `62e6f29d4016` and `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Leg B, string verbatim** (`const chunk = typeof event === 'string'` to `const chunk = res.vercelDataStream && typeof event === 'string'`, blob `62e6f29d4016` to `91002889678f`): unit 1 of 4 red (the `/mcp/skill` row; the Vercel row stays green), conformance 2 of 2 red. Restored the same way. A first attempt at this leg was a no-op: its replacement contained its anchor, `ablation-replace` refused it (anchor count 1 to 1) and ran no test, so that reading is void and the leg was rerun with the anchor above.

Both subjects resolve to source (the hono suite imports `./index`; http-conformance aliases `@objectstack/hono` to `src/index.ts`), so neither leg needed a rebuild. No ablation file is committed.

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `32900fd25` (merge base `30da04f8e`): 66 commands, all run, 66 exit 0. `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, no `dist/` for 34 packages); after the workspace build that `pnpm check:type-check-debt` runs, it was re-run: exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 66 derived, 66 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, every line carrying its exit code. `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the three changed TypeScript files: exit 0, no output. The repo-wide `pnpm lint`, the type-check lanes and the path-scheduled CI jobs are CI's.

## Acceptance notes

Observations, not filed (each a reading of code with no producer exercising it, or an unmeasured inference):

- Remaining differences between this arm and the standalone writer, none exercised by a producer today: the arm answers `200` whatever `result.status` says (both producers mean `200`); a `null` event is framed as `data: null` where the standalone writer skips it; a stream that throws is closed silently where the standalone writer writes an `event: error` frame; and the `Connection: keep-alive` default stays when a producer sets other headers (the standalone writer sends only the producer's). Owner: none.
- `runtime/src/domains/ai.ts` builds its own headers for a stream and does not pass the AI route's, so on a `createHonoApp` host a Vercel data stream from `service-ai@10.3.0` would carry `Content-Type: text/plain; charset=utf-8` and none of the route's `x-vercel-ai-ui-message-stream`, `x-objectstack-agent` or `x-objectstack-skills`, which the standalone route mount writes. Read from code and the published tarball only, NOT MEASURED at a door. Owner: none.
